name: Mozdok-Grozny Gas Pipeline

values.RouteType: Not mapped (but could be — route or endpoints are known)
values.RouteNotes: Runs in the same technical corridor as the Stavropol-Grozny pipeline; crosses the Terek river by microtunnel (>360 m); Mozdok CS (North Ossetia) to Grozny GDS. No official GIS found; candidate for the route-creation ladder (docs/sops/route_creation.md).

researcher_notes: Not a duplicate: roster has no Grozny/Chechnya row (checked GGIT 20260930 snapshot full-text for grozn/chechn/mozdok); P2343 Mozdok-Nevinnomyssk runs west, P5875 Mozdok-Tbilisi south, P0751/P1471 are trunks into Mozdok. New row, operating gas transmission, built-not-captured. Gazprom press release 7 Apr 2021 (gazprom.ru, via Wayback because the origin times out from here; capture verified): opened in Grozny, 101.7 km, 720 mm, same corridor as Stavropol-Grozny, 13 road and 6 water crossings incl. Terek, feeds Grozny TPP (360 MW), Grozny GDS 247 th m3/h. Gazprom Transgaz Stavropol release 11 Dec 2020 (Wayback, verified): construction complete in Mozdok LPUMG zone, starts at Mozdok CS, ends at Grozny GDS, 720 mm, >100 km, tied into Mozdok-Nevinnomyssk and Novopskov-Aksai-Mozdok. Independent re-reports: EADaily (quotes Gazprom), AK&M. Vesti.ru gives 101.73 km but diameter 700 mm vs 720 mm elsewhere: 720 mm is the Gazprom figure, used. Capacity 4.345 bcm/y is the design average annual throughput in federal territorial plan 816-r (item 60, as amended; sudact.ru mirror) and is a plan value, so treat as design capacity, medium on that field. Plan item lists North Ossetia-Alania (Mozdok district) to Chechnya (Nadterechny, Grozny districts), confirming endpoints and region. Owner Gazprom PJSC (entity exists in tracker as 'Gazprom PJSC'); operating subsidiaries are Gazprom Transgaz Stavropol / Gazprom Transgaz Grozny (not added as owner). StartYear1 2021 from the 7 Apr 2021 opening. ConstructionYear/ConstructionMonth left blank: a web search summary said construction began in 2018 but no verified page stating the start year was found (Wayback of Gazprom pages only gave completion), so not filled to avoid an orphan or unverified value. Length is also stated at 101.73 km by Vesti; 101.7 used. Route: none mapped; no official GIS; endpoints known (Mozdok CS to Grozny GDS) so RouteType 'Not mapped (but could be)', RouteAccuracy 'no route'. Overall tier high: length, diameter, status, endpoints verified by primary Gazprom releases plus independent re-reports. Passes add-threshold: operating (built), sponsor Gazprom, endpoints known, length 101.7 km >= 25 km sourced.
